parts.name: DateRangePickerRoot
parts.description: Holds the picker's range and open state, and provides them, with the options given here once, to the two fields, the trigger, the popup and the calendar. It renders no element of its own, only the Popover underneath and, with a name or inside a FieldRoot, the two hidden date inputs that submit the range.

props.name: value
props.description: The range, `{ start, end }` (`Temporal.PlainDate`s). Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the picker; `null` is a controlled picker with no range. A range that changes replaces both fields; while it stays the same, a side being typed is kept.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The range at first, when the picker isn't controlled. A form reset puts it back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the range when both fields are complete and either changes (each digit typed into a year too), or the calendar completes one, and with undefined when a complete range becomes incomplete. A start after the end is reported as typed, and is invalid. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popup is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it: the browser's popover follows it, and an owner that keeps it true through Escape or a press outside has the popup shown again.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popup is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the popup opens or closes.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest valid date: earlier days can't be picked, and a typed one is kept and invalid.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest valid date: later days can't be picked, and a typed one is kept and invalid.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Days that can't be picked, nor be inside a picked range. A typed one is kept and invalid.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the fields' segments and the calendar's names.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday).

props.name: placeholderValue
props.description: What an empty segment starts from when stepped with the arrow keys.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables both fields' segments, the trigger, so the popup can't open, and the hidden inputs.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The segments take focus but not edits, and the trigger is disabled.

props.name: required
props.description: Both dates are required.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the range as `<name>-start` and `<name>-end` (ISO dates), as RangeCalendarRoot does.

props.name: startName
props.description: The start date's name with a form.

props.name: endName
props.description: The end date's name with a form.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form the hidden inputs belong to, when they aren't inside it.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether completing a range in the calendar closes the popup.

props.name: incompleteMessage
props.description: The validation message while a field is partly filled.

props.name: unavailableMessage
props.description: The validation message for a date `isDateUnavailable` refuses.

props.name: rangeOrderMessage
props.default: "The end date is before the start date."
props.description: The start input's validation message while the start is after the end.

parts.name: DateRangePickerGroup
parts.description: The start field, the separator, the end field and the trigger in one `role="group"`. Name it with a FieldLabel, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`; the trigger, the popup and the calendar are named by the same label. It is the anchor the popup is placed against (`anchor-name`).

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field's value has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while focus is in the group.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while either date is outside min/max, unavailable or partly typed, the start is after the end, or the Field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is valid.

parts.name: DateRangePickerStart
parts.description: The start date: the Date Field's root, given the range's start and the picker's options. Put a DateFieldInput with its DateFieldSegments inside. A group of its own, named "Start date" (pass `aria-label` to translate). It has `data-invalid` while the start is partly typed, unavailable or after the end.

parts.name: DateRangePickerEnd
parts.description: The end date: the Date Field's root, given the range's end and the picker's options. A group of its own, named "End date" (pass `aria-label` to translate). It has `data-invalid` while the end is partly typed, unavailable or before the start.

parts.name: DateRangePickerSeparator
parts.description: What sits between the two fields, hidden from assistive technology (which hears "Start date" and "End date"). It shows its children.

parts.name: DateRangePickerTrigger
parts.description: The button that opens and closes the popup: the native `popovertarget`. It is named "Calendar" and the picker's label, has `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, and is disabled while the picker is disabled or read-only. Completing a range puts focus back on it.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present on the trigger while its popup is open.

parts.name: DateRangePickerPopup
parts.description: The native `popover` holding the calendar, with `role="dialog"`, named by the picker's label, placed under the group with CSS anchor positioning.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the group it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the group it lines up with.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: The gap between the group and the popup, in pixels.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Moves the popup along the group's edge, in pixels, when `align` isn't "center".

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.

parts.name: DateRangePickerCalendar
parts.description: The range Calendar's root, given the picker's range and options. Put the Calendar's own parts inside. Opening the popup focuses the range's start, else today, and drops a range left half-chosen; completing a range closes the popup and focuses the trigger, unless the root's `closeOnSelect` is false. While a range is under way, the first Escape cancels it and the second closes the popup. A start after the end shows no range.

props.name: allowsNonContiguousRanges
props.description: Lets a range include unavailable days.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-pending
dataAttributes.description: Present while a range is under way: its first day has been pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-range
dataAttributes.description: Always present: the calendar picks a range.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is read-only.
